lines.en: label yasuspring1:
scene yuusroom
I wake up to the taste of pencil lead as I must have absentmindedly fallen asleep while writing out my career sheet last night.
lines.zh: 我醒来时嘴里一股铅笔芯的味道——昨晚写职业志愿表的时候，大概就这么不知不觉睡着了。

lines.en: That happens sometimes — particularly when certain angles line up perfectly (or imperfectly based on whether or not you enjoy the taste of pencil lead).
lines.zh: 这种事偶尔会发生——尤其是当某些角度刚好对上（算不算「刚好」，取决于你喜不喜欢铅笔芯的味道）。

lines.en: I’m not sure what I want to be just yet, but I’m leaning toward an astronaut or something similar so I can get back at the aliens who killed Saki’s parents.
lines.zh: 我还不确定自己将来想干什么，但目前倾向于宇航员之类的，这样我就能去找害死 Saki 父母的外星人算账。

lines.en: I imagine they’re much better at hand-to-hand combat than me. But if there is anything I have learned from anime, it’s that willpower always trumps actual skill.
lines.zh: 我想他们近身格斗大概比我强得多。不过要说我从动画里学到了什么，那就是意志力永远胜过真本事。

lines.en: Until it doesn’t, at least. But Saki can tell you more about that than I can.
lines.zh: 至少在它不灵之前是这样。不过这一点 Saki 比我更有发言权。

lines.en: : Right, Saki?
lines.zh: : 对吧，Saki？

lines.en: show sakisurprised
: Hm? Did you say something?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你刚才说什么？

lines.en: : Why did you put this pencil in my mouth?
lines.zh: : 你为什么把这根铅笔塞进我嘴里？

lines.en: : I didn’t put any pencil in your mouth. Why would I put a pencil in your mouth?
lines.zh: : 我没往你嘴里塞什么铅笔。我为什么要往你嘴里塞铅笔？

lines.en: She raises a good point. Saki has never inserted any sort of writing utensil into my mouth before — at least to my knowledge.
lines.zh: 她说得有道理。Saki 以前从没往我嘴里塞过任何书写工具——至少据我所知没有。

lines.en: But that just means she {i}could{/i} and then probably get away with it since I’m so forgiving and easygoing.
lines.zh: 但这只说明她{i}塞得成{/i}，而且八成还能蒙混过去，毕竟我这人又宽容又好说话。

lines.en: : Okay, you’re off the hook for now. But I’ll be keeping an eye on you, you hear me?
lines.zh: : 好吧，这次先放过你。但我会盯紧你的，听见没有？

lines.en: show sakiangry
: You need to stop stalling and fill out your career sheet. We only have one more day before we have to turn it in.
lines.zh: : 你别再磨蹭了，快把志愿表填了。我们只剩一天就得交了。

lines.en: : Am I barred from having any sort of career for the rest of my life if I don’t meet the deadline?
lines.zh: : 要是没赶上截止日期，我这辈子是不是就永远不能从事任何职业了？

lines.en: : Yes. You’ll receive a mark on your permanent record that will follow you for the rest of your life before ending up as a janitor or some other job no one else wants to do.
lines.zh: : 是的。你的永久档案上会记一笔，跟着你一辈子，最后去当清洁工，或者别的没人愿意干的活。

lines.en: : I think that’s probably offensive to janitors.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这话对清洁工大概有点冒犯。

lines.en: : Well, you’ll know for sure in five years when you {i}are{/i} one.
lines.zh: : 那你五年后自己也{i}当上了{/i}，就知道了。

lines.en: : I’m just going to write “husband” on mine. Then, you can write “wife” on yours and we can match.
lines.zh: : 我就在我的表上写「丈夫」。然后你在你的表上写「妻子」，我们就能配成一对。

lines.en: show sakiembarrassed
: But...I already wrote that I want to be a teacher...
lines.zh: : 可是……我已经写了想当老师了……

lines.en: : Well, darn. Guess that just means I’ll have to find another bride. Do you think Miu still-
lines.zh: : 哎呀，真不巧。看来我只好另找一个新娘了。你觉得 Miu 还——

lines.en: show sakiangry
: Hmph!
: Oh, right. You get jealous when I talk about her.
lines.zh: : 哦对。我一提她你就会吃醋。

lines.en: : I do not.
lines.zh: : 我才不会。

lines.en: : Then what was the “hmph” for?
lines.zh: : 那你「哼」什么？

lines.en: : I was just clearing my throat. That was a throat-clearing noise.
lines.zh: : 我只是清清嗓子。那是清嗓子的声音。

lines.en: : Is there pencil lead stuck in yours as well?
lines.zh: : 你嗓子里也卡了铅笔芯吗？

lines.en: : That’s it. You’re clearly helpless without me, so I’m just going to fill out your career sheet on my own.
lines.zh: : 行了。没有我你显然活不下去，志愿表我自己帮你填。

lines.en: : Use a pen. The ink doesn’t taste as bad.
lines.zh: : 用钢笔。墨水的味道没那么难吃。

lines.en: Saki and I are in love, I think.
lines.zh: 我想，Saki 和我是相爱的。

lines.en: She’s the first thing that pops into my mind after I greet the world each morning, and the last thing on it just after wishing goodnight to Josh.
lines.zh: 每天早上我向这个世界问好之后，第一个浮现在脑海里的是她；晚上跟 Josh 道过晚安之后，最后一个也是她。

lines.en: scene black
We’ll probably start a family one day. That’s what you’re supposed to do when you’re in love, you know.
lines.zh: 我们大概有一天会组建家庭。相爱的人就该这么做，你知道的。

lines.en: And with my school life on the verge of ending once and for all, maybe it will be sooner rather than later?
lines.zh: 而我这段校园生活眼看就要彻底结束，也许那一天会比想象中来得更早？

lines.en: I say, not having even experienced my first kiss yet.
lines.zh: 我这么说，可我连初吻都还没有过。

lines.en: Saki wants to try, but she’s hesitant because she doesn’t have a sweet tooth.
lines.zh: Saki 想试试，但她有点犹豫，因为她不爱吃甜的。

lines.en: I guess it doesn’t matter, though.
lines.zh: 不过我想这也无所谓。

lines.en: It’s only a matter of time until life changes for good.
lines.zh: 生活迟早要彻底变个样。

lines.en: And when it does-
lines.zh: 等到那时候——

lines.en: Maybe all these cavities will start to go away.
lines.zh: 也许这些蛀牙都会开始好转。

lines.en: I’ve never held a baby before.
lines.zh: 我从来没抱过婴儿。

lines.en: scene lr2_day
: I’m off! I’ll be back in a few hours, okay?
lines.zh: : 我出门啦！几个小时后就回来，好不好？

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re ready?
lines.zh: : 你确定自己准备好了吗？

lines.en: : Nope! But there’s only one way to find out and that’s by facing things head-on!
lines.zh: : 不确定！但只有一种办法能知道答案，就是迎面而上！

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : {i}Save it for later, Dad! Gotta go!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}留着以后再说吧，爸爸！我得走了！{/i}

lines.en: Ami’s been doing better lately.
lines.zh: Ami 最近状态好多了。

lines.en: The camping trip probably helped in some way.
lines.zh: 那次露营大概起了点作用。

lines.en: Either that or the fact that being able to refer to me as “Dad” now has lifted off some of the weight that’s been keeping her grounded all these years.
lines.zh: 要么就是现在能叫我「爸爸」这件事，卸下了这些年来压在她身上的一部分重量。

lines.en: But what that means is now I have to worry about her floating away.
lines.zh: 但这也意味着，现在轮到我担心她会飘走了。

lines.en: I tied a leash around her so that doesn’t happen.
lines.zh: 我在她身上系了根绳子，免得她飘走。

lines.en: A symbolic one, if you will. Not an actual leash, despite how greatly she’d prefer such a thing.
lines.zh: 象征意义上的绳子，随你怎么理解。不是真的绳子——尽管她本人倒是非常希望是真的。

lines.en: I promised I’d make this house more of a home.
lines.zh: 我答应过她，要把这个房子变得更像个家。

lines.en: But, of course, I conveniently left out the detail where doing such a thing would require the assistance of another woman who could function as a mother figure for her.
lines.zh: 但我当然很「贴心」地略过了这样一个细节：要做到这件事，需要另一个女人来帮忙，充当一个母亲的角色。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say you can’t have a {i}home{/i} with one parent. It’s just impossible to do such a thing when that one parent is me as I don’t even know how to take care of myself.
lines.zh: 我不是说单亲就不能有个{i}家{/i}。只是当那个唯一的家长是我的时候，这事根本不可能——毕竟我连自己都照顾不好。

lines.en: But I’m trying.
lines.zh: 但我在努力。

lines.en: Which means that, today...I am going to clean the house.
lines.zh: 也就是说，今天……我要打扫房子。

lines.en: Or not.
lines.zh: 还是算了。

lines.en: : {i}Hello? Is anyone home?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}请问有人在家吗？{/i}

lines.en: : ...Yasu?
lines.zh: : ……Yasu？

lines.en: : {i}Can you spare a moment to talk about our lord and savior?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}能耽误你一点时间，聊聊我们的主和救主吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah. Definitely Yasu.
lines.zh: : 嗯。绝对是 Yasu 没错。

lines.en: scene black
Unsure of what she’s doing here or...how she even found my house in the first place, I abandon my goal of lightening Ami’s load and hope that spiteful gravity does all of the work for me.
lines.zh: 我不知道她来这儿干什么，也不知道她到底是怎么找到我家的，于是我放弃了替 Ami 减轻负担的打算，只希望这恼人的重力能替我把活全干了。

lines.en: Especially since there’s no way I’m comfortable with letting Yasu roam around my neighborhood when I know how easily she gets lost.
lines.zh: 尤其是我可不敢让 Yasu 在我家附近乱转——她有多容易迷路，我是知道的。

lines.en: But I guess we’re all prone to getting “lost” in our own ways. And I’m sure I’d prefer hers to whatever I’ve been doing ever since {i}She{/i} turned into meat.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我们每个人都有自己的「迷路」方式。而且我敢肯定，比起自从{i}她{/i}变成肉之后我一直在干的事，她那种迷路我更愿意接受。

lines.en: scene yasufliers1
It must be nice believing in something that isn’t there.
lines.zh: 能相信一个并不存在的东西，一定很美好吧。

lines.en: God not actually existing means that it or It can’t ever leave you when those who are tangible actually can, and it’s that sort of security that I think would make it easier to get out of bed each morning.
lines.zh: 神其实并不存在，意味着它——或者祂——永远不会离开你，而那些实实在在的人却真的会。我想，正是这种安全感，能让人每天早上更容易爬起来。

lines.en: Now, every time I step outside of my house, I do nothing but wonder which part of me I’ll lose along the way.
lines.zh: 而现在，每次踏出家门，我所想的只有：这一路上，我又会丢掉自己的哪一部分。

lines.en: I’m just a lamb, after all.
lines.zh: 我终究只是一只小羊羔。

lines.en: But it appears my shepherd has come to corral me.
lines.zh: 但看来我的牧羊人来圈我了。

lines.en: : What lives not in the shadows thrives in the sun.
lines.zh: : 不活在阴影里的，必在阳光下繁盛。

lines.en: : And “good morning” to you as well.
lines.zh: : 也祝你「早上好」。

lines.en: : I didn’t know you lived here.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你住在这里。

lines.en: : And I didn’t know you were a door-to-door salesman now.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道你现在改行当上门推销员了。

lines.en: scene yasufliers2
: I am no salesman, just a merchant of salvation.
lines.zh: : 我不是推销员，只是救赎的商人。

lines.en: : I feel like that line is being underutilized by the others working in your field.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你们这行其他人太埋没这句台词了。

lines.en: : There are no others. But that is why I appear before you today in all of my unwantedness.
lines.zh: : 没有其他人。所以今天我才以这副不受欢迎的模样出现在你面前。

lines.en: : Can you spare a moment to talk about our lord and-
lines.zh: : 能耽误你一点时间，聊聊我们的主和——

lines.en: : {i}Your{/i} lord. You already know I don’t believe in that stuff.
lines.zh: : {i}你的{/i}主。你明明知道我不信那一套。

lines.en: scene yasufliers3
: But I also know that you have {i}seen{/i} such “stuff,” which is what makes your acceptance all but inevitable once the fear is expelled from your vessel.
lines.zh: : 但我也知道，你亲眼{i}见过{/i}那「一套」。所以只要把你这具器皿里的恐惧赶出去，你接受信仰就是迟早的事。

lines.en: : Are you really handing out fliers right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在真的在发传单？

lines.en: scene yasufliers4
: Touka suggested that it would be a good idea...but no one is opening the door for me.
lines.zh: : Touka 说这是个好主意……但没有一个人愿意给我开门。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’ll happen. The only reason I answered in the first place was because I recognized your voice. And I guess also because I hate cleaning.
lines.zh: : 嗯，正常。我之所以会应门，纯粹是因为听出了你的声音。大概还因为我讨厌打扫卫生。

lines.en: scene yasufliers5
: That fills me with an unbearable sadness as my mission is to help you clean your soul...
lines.zh: : 这让我感到难以承受的悲伤，因为我的使命是帮你清洁灵魂……

lines.en: : I’m surprised you’re making this a mission in the first place since I thought your church was closed off to anyone who isn’t “chosen.”
lines.zh: : 你还把这事当成使命，我挺意外的。我记得你的教堂不是只对「被选中」的人开放吗？

lines.en: scene yasufliers6
: It is true that His doors remain locked to those without keys in their hearts. But the weakening of His whispers has forced my hand into turning these heretic tides into ones that we can wade in.
lines.zh: : 的确，祂的门对心中无钥者是锁着的。但祂的低语正在变弱，逼得我不得不出手，把这异端的浪潮变成我们可以涉足的浅滩。

lines.en: : So please, do me the favor of cutting your flesh on the shells of truth we can pluck from the sands of this city.
lines.zh: : 所以拜托了，帮个忙，来这片城市的沙滩上捡拾真理的贝壳，让你的肉被割开吧。

lines.en: : So...hand out fliers with you?
lines.zh: : 也就是……跟你一起发传单？

lines.en: : Help deliver righteousness and love to those who need it most.
lines.zh: : 把正义与爱送到最需要的人手上。

lines.en: : So...everyone who isn’t already one of “His” followers?
lines.zh: : 也就是……所有还不是「祂」信徒的人？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : So just everyone.
lines.zh: : 那就是所有人呗。

lines.en: scene yasufliers7
: The truth is so visible, yet so blinding all at once. It is no wonder most can’t help but shield their eyes from the glow of salvation...
lines.zh: : 真理如此显而易见，同时又如此刺眼。难怪大多数人都忍不住要遮住眼睛，躲避救赎的光芒……

lines.en: I mean...I {i}guess{/i} I can help her out?
lines.zh: 我意思是……我{i}大概{/i}能帮帮她？

lines.en: But I’m also not sure if I {i}should{/i} since I feel like all it would do is get her hopes up that someone might actually take her seriously when she tells them she can hear the voice of God.
lines.zh: 但我也拿不准{i}该不该{/i}帮，因为我感觉这么做只会让她更抱期待——以为真有人会把「她能听见上帝的声音」当回事。

lines.en: {b}meanwhile, akira “sad boy” arakawa converses with a mysterious voice inside HIS sorrow-filled head and pretends he doesn’t hear shit{/b}
lines.zh: {b}与此同时，akira「悲伤男孩」arakawa 正跟他那颗装满悲伤的脑袋里一个神秘声音对话，还装作自己什么都没听见{/b}

lines.en: scene yasufliers8
I hear you loud and clear.
lines.zh: 我听得清清楚楚。

lines.en: {b}rad, then invite her inside and give her some of that sweet loving you’re going to give to her friend with the massive honkers{/b}
lines.zh: {b}酷，那就请她进来，给她一点你准备用在她那个巨乳朋友身上的甜蜜疼爱{/b}

lines.en: No thanks. Touka would kill me and I don’t see Yasu that way.
lines.zh: 谢了不用。Touka 会杀了我，而且我没把 Yasu 当那种人看。

lines.en: {b}LIAR. YOU SEE EVERY TEENAGE COCK-POCKET THAT WAY. plus, you already made her cum once and it was craaaaaaaazy{/b}
lines.zh: {b}骗子。只要是十几岁、带个洞的，你都当那种人看。再说了，你已经让她高潮过一次了，那叫一个疯——狂——{/b}

lines.en: : What is it you hear, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你听见了什么，Sensei？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Is it the whispers of the world? The stirring of the cicadas? Or perhaps the hum of an undying entity concealed beneath this colossal bed of worms?
lines.zh: : 是世界的低语？蝉鸣的骚动？还是藏在这张巨大的虫褥之下、某个不灭存在的嗡鸣？

lines.en: : Would you believe me if I told you the nagging yet sarcastic disembodied voice of a supernatural being?
lines.zh: : 要是我告诉你，是一个超自然存在那喋喋不休又阴阳怪气的无实体声音，你信吗？

lines.en: {b}your mom is a nagging disembodied voice. i’m more like a wingman who’s here to help you get your dick wet.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你妈才是喋喋不休的无实体声音。我更像个僚机，专门来帮你那话儿开开荤的。{/b}

lines.en: : Your blood is louder all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 你的血突然变响了。

lines.en: {b}yeah cause it’s all rushing to his big fat wiener.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}是啊，因为全往他那根又大又肥的香肠上涌呢。{/b}

lines.en: : Okay. Sure. I’ll help you hand out fliers, Yasu. Just as long as you promise to stop asking me about what I’m hearing so I can go back to pretending it isn’t there.
lines.zh: : 行。好。我帮你发传单，Yasu。只要你答应别再追问我听见了什么，好让我继续装作那东西不存在。

lines.en: scene yasufliers9

: Really? You’ll assist in the divine reassurance that the path of light will never fully darken, even in the coldest of winters?! And lift up His word so that all may gaze on in admiration and jubilance?!
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你愿意协助这神圣的保证——即便在最冷的冬天，光明之路也绝不会彻底暗去？！愿意高举祂的话语，让所有仰望的人都怀着敬慕与欢欣？！

lines.en: : I will help you hand out fliers.
lines.zh: : 我帮你发传单。

lines.en: scene yasufliers10
: That is how it begins...but it {i}ends{/i} with you on a throne of flesh, bathed in the residue of a job well done as He swallows the gifts you’ve provided.
lines.zh: : 一切就是这么开始的……但{i}结局{/i}是你坐上肉的宝座，沐浴在功德圆满后的残渍里，而祂吞下你所献上的贡品。

lines.en: scene yasufliers11
: Then, as the passerby’s gaze locks on the mountain of bodies you have both conquered and {i}saved,{/i} they will be forced to prostrate before Him and ascend the throne as well!
lines.zh: : 然后，当路人的目光锁定那座你既征服又{i}拯救{/i}的肉山，他们就不得不匍匐在祂面前，也登上那宝座！

lines.en: : Covered in the sweetest of all nectars, we’ll finally know what it means to be touched by the hand of God! We’ll finally know how it feels to-
lines.zh: : 浑身沾满最甜美的琼浆，我们终于会明白被上帝之手触碰意味着什么！我们终于会知道那是什么感觉——

lines.en: : Okay, never mind. I’m going back inside.
lines.zh: : 行了，当我没说。我回屋了。

lines.en: scene yasufliers12
: I apologize...I got a little too excited.
lines.zh: : 我道歉……我有点太激动了。

lines.en: : I’m just glad you started ranting about “the sweetest nectar” in front of me and not some other guy who hasn’t figured out you’re not all there yet.
lines.zh: : 我只能庆幸你是在我面前大谈「最甜美的琼浆」，而不是在别的、还没看出你有点不对劲的男人面前。

lines.en: : Not all where?
lines.zh: : 不对劲在哪？

lines.en: scene black
: Come on. There’s a small market nearby that you can probably hand some fliers out at.
lines.zh: : 走吧。附近有个小市场，你大概可以在那儿发一些传单。

lines.en: : Huh? But there are houses here that-
lines.zh: : 咦？可这里就有房子——

lines.en: : Don’t bother my neighbors, please. There’s no way they haven’t noticed the mass amount of teenage girls coming over to my house all the time and I don’t want them to think you’re one of mine.
lines.zh: : 别去烦我邻居，拜托。他们不可能没注意到，我家里老是有一大群女高中生进进出出，我可不想让他们以为你也是我的。

lines.en: scene yasufliers13
: I suppose that {i}would{/i} be problematic as I am one of His and His only.
lines.zh: : 那{i}确实{/i}会很麻烦，因为我是祂的，且只属于祂。

lines.en: : I think it’d be a little more problematic on my end, but you do you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在我这边会更麻烦一点，不过你随意。

lines.en: : This market — does it sell or trade unholy relics that may interfere with the message I am to deliver?
lines.zh: : 那个市场——卖不卖会干扰我要传递的信息的不洁遗物？

lines.en: : Depends. Are tomatoes unholy relics?
lines.zh: : 看情况。番茄算不洁遗物吗？

lines.en: scene yasufliers14
: Yes.
: Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: scene yasufliers15
: No.
lines.zh: : 不算。

lines.en: : Did Touka teach you what jokes are? Because they normally involve a little more than just lying to someone.
lines.zh: : Touka 教过你什么叫玩笑吗？因为玩笑通常不只是骗骗人而已。

lines.en: : Lying is a sin punishable by the immediate removal of your shortest fingernail.
lines.zh: : 说谎是一种罪，惩罚是立刻拔掉你最短的那片指甲。

lines.en: : What rule do I need to break before the longest one is removed?
lines.zh: : 那我得犯什么规，才能拔掉最长的那片？

lines.en: : Nine more lies.
lines.zh: : 再说九次谎。

lines.en: scene yasufliers16
: Okay. That one was good.
lines.zh: : 行。这个不错。

lines.en: : Teehee!
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻！

lines.en: : Don’t “Teehee” at me. I need you to be as un-cute as possible so that I don’t start perceiving you as a regular girl I can groom into another lamb that I will lead to slaughter.
lines.zh: : 别对我「嘻嘻」。我需要你尽可能不可爱，这样我才不会把你当成一个普通的、可以让我调教成另一只待宰羔羊的女孩。

lines.en: : I’m in a rather sensitive state right now and you’re one of the few who’s actually safe from me. Probably.
lines.zh: : 我现在状态挺脆弱的，而你是少数几个在我面前真正安全的人之一。大概吧。

lines.en: scene yasufliers17
: You are not planning on slaughtering Touka, are you? Because I love her and I want to save her.
lines.zh: : 你没打算宰了 Touka 吧？因为我爱她，我想救她。

lines.en: : Not intentionally at least. But if things keep progressing the way they did the last time I hung out in her room, it’s only a matter of time.
lines.zh: : 至少不是有意的。不过要是事情照上次我在她房间里那样发展下去，那只是时间问题。

lines.en: : What happened then?
lines.zh: : 那次发生了什么？

lines.en: : Something something throne ascension.
lines.zh: : 什么什么登基宝座。

lines.en: : But you have not yet built your throne. You must first devote yourself to Him. It is only then that you may engage in the act of transference.
lines.zh: : 可你还没建起你的宝座。你必须先把自己奉献给祂。只有到那时，你才能进行传递之仪。

lines.en: : Yasu, I have some very bad news for you.
lines.zh: : Yasu，我有个很坏的消息要告诉你。

lines.en: scene yasufliers18
: I have already heard. There will be new houses here soon, and I will have to make one more pilgrimage this far outside His area of influence.
lines.zh: : 我已经听说了。这里很快会有新的房子，而我将不得不再一次远行，走出祂的影响范围。

lines.en: : Okay, good. Because that’s exactly what I was going to say and I’m glad we’re on the same page.
lines.zh: : 好，很好。因为我要说的正是这个，很高兴我们想到一块去了。

lines.en: : I understand more than you think, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我懂的比你想的多，Sensei。

lines.en: : You sure do, Yasu. Just not in a way that I think you’re entirely conscious of.
lines.zh: : 你确实懂，Yasu。只是不是以你自己完全意识到的那种方式。

lines.en: : My consciousness is questionable in the first place, for my existence hinges entirely on His. Making me little more than a mite in the scales of Catherine.
lines.zh: : 我的意识本来就可疑，因为我的存在完全依附于祂的存在。这让我不过成了 Catherine 鳞片上的一只螨虫。

lines.en: : Who the hell is Catherine?
lines.zh: : Catherine 到底是谁？

lines.en: : A friend of Miss Imai’s.
lines.zh: : Imai 小姐的一个朋友。

lines.en: : Oh great. One more girl who’s destined to fall for me.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。又一个注定要爱上我的女孩。

lines.en: : That would be a sin so great that not even He could save you.
lines.zh: : 那是连祂都救不了你的大罪。

lines.en: : Now, I don’t want to just {i}assume{/i} your god is racist. But based on context clues, I think I kind of have to now.
lines.zh: : 我本来不想随便{i}假定{/i}你的神有种族歧视。但根据上下文线索，我现在觉得自己不得不这么想了。

lines.en: : God does not see color.
lines.zh: : 上帝不看肤色。

lines.en: : Then why do you have a dress code that varies season by season?
lines.zh: : 那你的着装规范为什么还要跟着季节变？

lines.en: scene yasufliers19
: To optimize how much of Him I can absorb, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是为了优化我能吸收多少祂。

lines.en: : But...it goes by-
lines.zh: : 可是……那是按——

lines.en: : It’s all for the sake of absorption.
lines.zh: : 一切都是为了吸收。

lines.en: : Among other things.
lines.zh: : 也为了别的事。

lines.en: scene black
: Right...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Anyway, the market is just over here...
lines.zh: : 总之，市场就在那边……

lines.en: scene yasufliers20
Yasu hands me her stack of fliers before approaching a vendor and beginning her spiel.
lines.zh: Yasu 把那叠传单塞给我，然后走向一个摊贩，开始了她的那套说辞。

lines.en: I accept them begrudgingly (mostly because I wanted to actually buy a few things for the house while I’m here and I require my arms to do that), but I decide against interjecting until Yasu’s been properly rejected.
lines.zh: 我很不情愿地接了过来（主要是因为我想趁来这一趟给家里买点东西，而这需要腾出双手），但我决定先不插嘴，等 Yasu 被正式拒绝再说。

lines.en: Which she will be, because she’s a lunatic.
lines.zh: 她一定会被拒绝的，因为她就是个疯子。

lines.en: But I’m also a lunatic. And one who hallucinates strange creatures while talking to myself and breaking some of the most heinous laws out there — only to be rewarded for doing so with fresh meat.
lines.zh: 可我也是个疯子。一个会一边跟自己说话、一边看见奇怪生物的疯子，一个犯了天底下最令人发指的罪行、却因此得到鲜肉作为奖赏的疯子。

lines.en: So maybe a success isn’t entirely out of the cards after all.
lines.zh: 所以，也许成功并非完全不可能。

lines.en: : Hello. I’m Yasu Yasui — an angel in training. Can you spare a moment of your time to talk about our lord and savior?
lines.zh: : 你好。我叫 Yasu Yasui——一名见习天使。能耽误你一点时间，聊聊我们的主和救主吗？

lines.en: The vendor is an old man — one who barely makes a noise, clinging to what little life he’s got left in him by spending his days selling spices and teas.
lines.zh: 摊主是个老人——几乎不出声，靠着每天卖香料和茶叶，勉强吊住自己剩下的一口气。

lines.en: He gazes up at Yasu as his spine, contorted by age, makes her several inches taller than him. But his eyes are not filled with curiosity toward her cause, nor do they linger longer than they’re supposed to on her body.
lines.zh: 他抬头看着 Yasu——被岁月压弯的脊背让她比他高出好几英寸。但他的眼神里没有对她那番事业的好奇，也没有在她身上多停留半分。

lines.en: They hone in on her flier — picking up key words and trying to make sense of the images despite them very likely meaning absolutely nothing to anyone outside Yasu’s circle of one.
lines.zh: 它们锁定在她的传单上——挑出几个关键词，试图弄懂那些图画的意思，尽管那些东西对 Yasu 那个只有一个人的小圈子之外的任何人，很可能都毫无意义。

lines.en: He shrugs the flier off and turns his back to Yasu, but she speaks out before he’s able to go into hiding behind stacks of cardboard boxes.
lines.zh: 他把传单推到一边，转过身去背对 Yasu，但她在他躲到一摞摞纸箱后面之前开口了。

lines.en: scene yasufliers21
: He will rip you into a million tiny pieces if you do not heed my call.
lines.zh: : 你若不回应我的召唤，祂会把你撕成百万个碎片。

lines.en: scene yasufliers22
Not knowing which “He” Yasu is referring to, the man quickly looks at me and recoils- stepping backward and knocking over several crates of spices.
lines.zh: 不知道 Yasu 说的是哪个「祂」，那男人赶紧看向我，往后一缩——一退步，撞翻了好几箱香料。

lines.en: : Yasu, don’t say “He” when I’m with you. People are going to assume you’re talking about me.
lines.zh: : Yasu，别在我旁边说「祂」。别人会以为你在说我。

lines.en: : Also, don’t threaten old people with the powers of your god. It’s bad manners.
lines.zh: : 还有，别拿你神的权能去威胁老人。很没礼貌。

lines.en: : I will try to remember that, but my mind is a sea of trees planted by His hand only, and there is not much room left for you to sow your seed.
lines.zh: : 我会努力记住的，但我的脑海是由祂的手种下的一片树海，已经没多少地方给你播种了。

lines.en: : Again, I have no intention of “sowing my seed” anywhere near you.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，我没有任何打算在你附近「播种」。

lines.en: Unless she just happens to be in the room when I eventually have sex with Touka. Which she probably will be since the two of them are mostly inseparable.
lines.zh: 除非等我最终跟 Touka 上床的时候，她刚好就在房间里。而她大概率会在，因为她俩基本形影不离。

lines.en: scene yasufliers23
: I will start over then!
lines.zh: : 那我重新开始！

lines.en: scene black
: Can you spare a moment of your time in exchange for a better life?
lines.zh: : 能耽误你一点时间，换一个更好的人生吗？

lines.en: I follow Yasu around until she’s spoken to every vendor at every stall in the market.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Yasu 走，直到她跟市场里每一个摊位的每一个摊主都说过了。

lines.en: There aren’t many of them, but I’ve noticed over time that new ones {i}are{/i} appearing.
lines.zh: 摊子不多，但我渐渐注意到，新的摊子{i}在{/i}冒出来。

lines.en: Once again, it’s like the town moves.
lines.zh: 又一次，就像这座镇子在移动。

lines.en: But the people in it, {i}us...{/i}we remain mostly still.
lines.zh: 可镇子里的人，{i}我们……{/i}基本还是一动不动。

lines.en: There are those like Ami who face terrible hardships and somehow manage to crawl out of them.
lines.zh: 有像 Ami 这样的人，面对可怕的苦难，却总能想办法爬出来。

lines.en: Then there are people like me who face similar things, yet struggle greatly when it comes to going back to normal.
lines.zh: 也有像我这样的人，遇到类似的事，却很难回到正常。

lines.en: But I guess there are also people like Yasu.
lines.zh: 但我想，还有像 Yasu 这样的人。

lines.en: People who {i}do{/i} move.
lines.zh: {i}会动{/i}的人。

lines.en: She’s making a stride with whatever this is.
lines.zh: 她在朝某个方向迈出一步，不管这一步算什么。

lines.en: I can tell it’s hard for her.
lines.zh: 我看得出这对她来说很难。

lines.en: But I can also tell it’s failing...
lines.zh: 但我也看得出，这事正在失败……

lines.en: And that makes separating from her after we leave the market so much harder as I know she has so much more of that failure ahead of her.
lines.zh: 正因为如此，离开市场后跟她分别才格外难受——我知道前面还有无数次这样的失败在等着她。

lines.en: But she doesn’t seem perturbed in the slightest.
lines.zh: 可她似乎一点也不气馁。

lines.en: She smiles, clutching her fliers close to her chest, and says to me before leaving-
lines.zh: 她笑着，把传单紧紧抱在胸前，临走前对我说了——

lines.en: “They will come when they have to.”
lines.zh: 「他们该来的时候就会来。」

lines.en: “I just know it.”
lines.zh: 「我就是知道。」

lines.en: We part ways, but her words remain with me.
lines.zh: 我们分开了，但她的话留在我心里。

lines.en: I don’t think mine ever stuck to her.
lines.zh: 我想，我的话一句也没留在她那儿。

$ yasu_love += 1
{i}Yasu’s affection has increased to [yasu_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yasu 的好感度提升到了 [yasu_love]!{/i}
